gloss: treatment (usually unkind); way of treating someone

definitions.explanation: The way someone treats another person, almost always meaning harsh, unfair or cruel treatment. It expresses the speaker's resentment.

examples.japanese: ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{仕打|しう}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{恩人|おんじん}→恩人：02566_onjin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{仕打|しう}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can't treat the person who helped me like that.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{尽|つ}くして→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧きた⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧{仕打|しう}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I never thought the company I had served for so many years would treat me this way.

notes:
Almost always negative, often with ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧, ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧ or ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧/⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧. A neutral word for "treatment" is ⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧ or, for treatment of people by an organization, ⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧{仕打|しう}ち: cruel treatment
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{仕打|しう}ち: cold treatment
- {仕打|しう}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be treated (badly)
- {仕打|しう}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to put up with harsh treatment
